info.title: CookApp Cloud Backend API
info.description:
Supabase-backed API for CookApp. Primary data access is PostgREST (`/rest/v1`)
with Row Level Security. Privileged operations use Edge Functions (`/functions/v1`).

Authentication: Supabase Auth session JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`).
Third-party OAuth tokens are never stored server-side.

Project: `semsjyrqjnumpvanibip` · Base: `https://semsjyrqjnumpvanibip.supabase.co`

post.description:
Supabase Auth endpoint. Clients use the Supabase SDK for Apple ID token,
Google OAuth, logout, and refresh. Documented for completeness.
Purges user storage objects and deletes the auth user (cascades all owned rows).

Server-to-server. Auth via `Authorization: Bearer <REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET>`.
JWT verification disabled; service role used internally.

Issues a custom admin bearer session (not end-user JWT).
Production rejects default `admin`/`admin` credentials (Issue #51).
Set `COOKAPP_ADMIN_ALLOW_DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS=true` or `COOKAPP_ADMIN_ENV=development`
only for local/dev.

Replaces the default seed account with a strong Owner password.
Requires current default password when a seed row exists.
Production requires header `X-CookApp-Bootstrap-Token` matching
secret `COOKAPP_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN` (never commit the token).
Local/dev may omit the token when `COOKAPP_ADMIN_ENV=development`.

400.description: Weak password or invalid bootstrap state

post.description: Revokes the current admin bearer session.

Requires strong password policy (min 12, upper, lower, digit).
Revokes all sessions for the account and returns a fresh token.

get.description:
List own recipes. For detail use `id=eq.<uuid>` (maps to GET /recipes/:id).
Update: `PATCH` with `id=eq.<uuid>` (PUT /recipes/:id).
Delete: `DELETE` with `id=eq.<uuid>` (DELETE /recipes/:id).
Table row uses `expires_at`. Prefer `/rest/v1/subscription_status` for spec-shaped `expire_date`.

200.description: Simplified subscription view matching Subscription Service contract

post.summary: Upload object (private bucket, path must start with auth user id)

get.summary: Download / signed access to own object

post.summary: Create single import job and enqueue for async worker
post.description:
Shared Backend AI Recipe Import pipeline (Issue #55).
Exact active source URL returns 409 DUPLICATE.
Uses AIRouter route_key (`recipe_import_text` / `recipe_import_vision`); no Admin-side model keys.
Job is enqueued on Supabase Queues (pgmq) — Issue #56. Worker runs pipeline asynchronously.

post.summary: Enqueue retry from a pipeline stage
Enqueue re-run AI parse from parse stage
Approve needs-review job and enqueue import
Create batch import and enqueue jobs (async)
post.description:
Returns immediately. Jobs are processed by recipe-import-worker
via Supabase Queues / pgmq (Issue #56). Single-job failure does not block the batch.

post.summary: Process recipe import queue (pgmq worker tick)
post.description:
Operational job type `recipe_import_worker` (Issue #56).
Reads up to `import_queue_concurrency` messages from Supabase Queues (pgmq),
calls shared `runImportPipeline`, archives on success / poison.
Server/cron only — auth via `Authorization: Bearer <RECIPE_IMPORT_WORKER_SECRET>`.
Concurrency / VT / max attempts come from `runtime_config` (not secrets).

Operational job type `storage_cleanup_import_artifacts`.
Deletes Storage objects whose `recipe_import_artifact_objects.expires_at`
has passed and marks rows deleted. Server/cron only — auth via
`Authorization: Bearer <STORAGE_CLEANUP_SECRET>`.
Never uses permanent signed URLs; never returns service_role secrets.

Apikey.name: apikey
Apikey.description: Supabase anon key (required alongside JWT for PostgREST)

AdminBearer.description: Admin Dashboard session token from admin-auth/login (not end-user JWT)

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description:
Client-supplied request id. When omitted, the server generates a UUID.
Echoed on every Admin / webhook response and included in structured logs
and `admin_audit_logs.request_id`.

XCorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
XCorrelationId.description: Cross-service correlation id. Defaults to `X-Request-Id` when omitted.

XJobId.name: X-Job-Id
XJobId.description:
Optional async job / sync run id (import jobs, provider syncs, webhook
event id). Stored on audit rows and structured logs when present.

ErrorEnvelope.description:
Unified Edge Function error body. Always includes `request_id` (may be
null only on legacy paths that predate Issue #57). Secrets are never
returned in `details`.

DashboardData.description: Ops aggregation from admin-dashboard (#47). Source labels should be preserved by clients.

MealPlan.description: Spec field `date` is stored as `plan_date` (Postgres reserved-word safe).

RecipeImportCreateRequest.description: Provide sourceUrl and/or sourceText (text paste fallback).

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical Admin / Edge Function error envelope (Issue #57 / V2 §17).

AdminAuditLog.description: Row in `admin_audit_logs` (service_role only). Diffs are secret-redacted.

action.description:
e.g. admin.login, subscription_plan.update, ai.provider.update,
recipe.delete, user.admin_action, integration.config_update

MediaObjectMetadata.description:
Postgres metadata pattern for object storage (never base64/blobs).
Used by MediaStorageProvider and recipe_import_artifact_objects.

object_key.description:
Provider-agnostic object key. Import artifacts use `{job_id}/…`.
User media use `{user_id}/…`.

XRequestId.description: Request id for this response (echo or server-generated).
